backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (about 262K tokens per step). In a 300 s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE at 64 so gradient accumulation halves. No other changes.
backlog.title: Lower total batch to 2**18

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, which gives 2 micro-steps per step. This tests an even more step-heavy regime. If it is unstable, lower MATRIX_LR to 0.03.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**17

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more time is spent at full LR.
backlog.title: Shorter warmdown 0.3

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 for a longer decay phase.
backlog.title: Longer warmdown 0.7

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize the early Muon and Adam updates.
backlog.title: Short warmup 0.03

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05

backlog.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.06

backlog.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.4

backlog.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.
backlog.title: Unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Lower SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 to stabilize the per-layer scalars.
backlog.title: Scalar LR 0.25

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1. Short runs may need less regularization.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.3

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99). This makes the second-moment estimate smoother.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.99

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6. The model is smaller and faster, so it sees more tokens in 300 s. Keep ASPECT_RATIO 64, so dim is 384. Check that dim is divisible by HEAD_DIM. If it is not, set ASPECT_RATIO to 85, which gives 510, or adjust to the nearest multiple of 128, for example 512.
backlog.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO 64, which gives dim 640 and 5 heads at HEAD_DIM 128. Combine with TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**18 if the step count is too low. Tests whether a larger model wins despite fewer tokens.
backlog.title: Depth 10

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 to get twice as many heads. Check that flash attention and the rotary code handle it.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSL" or "SSL". Try "SSL" for more full-attention layers, or check that the last layer is always long.
backlog.title: All-long windows swap

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" so that fewer layers use full attention. This is faster per step, and the extra throughput may outweigh the loss.
backlog.title: Window pattern all S plus final L

backlog.spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 with DEPTH 8, which gives dim 640. This widens the model. The dim must be a multiple of HEAD_DIM, and 640 is 5 heads of 128.
backlog.title: Aspect ratio 80

backlog.spec: If the model uses a logit softcap, such as 15, change it to 10. If it has none, add 15*tanh(logits/15) before the loss during training only. Leave the evaluation path alone.
backlog.title: Logit softcap lower

backlog.spec: Replace the MLP activation relu(x)^2 with a gated unit. Use hidden = 8/3*dim rounded to a multiple of 64 so the parameter count stays the same. Compute silu(gate)*up.
backlog.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-lite

backlog.spec: Make sure the attention and MLP output projections (c_proj) are zero-initialized. If they are not, add zero init. If they already are, scale the init std of the c_fc and q/k/v weights by 0.8.
backlog.title: Zero-init output projections check

backlog.spec: Change the Muon momentum schedule so that it ramps from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 100 steps instead of the current ramp length. Then hold at 0.95. Optionally drop the final momentum to 0.9 in warmdown.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter

backlog.spec: Reduce the Newton-Schulz iterations in Muon from 5 to 4. This saves a little time per step. Check that the loss does not degrade.
backlog.title: Muon Newton-Schulz steps 4

backlog.spec: Check that the model runs in bf16 autocast with fused AdamW. If the lm_head or the embeddings are kept in fp32, cast the embeddings to bf16 to save memory bandwidth. Use that saving to try DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32 with the same total batch, in case it is faster.
backlog.title: torch compile max-autotune off, bf16 check

backlog.spec: If the model has value embeddings with gates, initialize the gate so it starts at about 0.5 of the output, or increase value embeddings to every layer. If it has none, skip this and apply a per-layer residual lambda init of 1.0 and x0 lambda of 0.1.
backlog.title: Value embedding gate tweak

backlog.spec: Skip this unless it is trivial. Add label smoothing 0.05 to the training loss only. Leave the evaluation untouched. Probably a small harm, but it is cheap to test.
backlog.title: Dropout-free label smoothing 0.05

backlog.spec: Start with TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE equal to 2**17 in the first 30% of the time budget, then use 2**19. Do this with a grad-accumulation count that depends on the progress fraction. Use LR scaling unchanged.
backlog.title: Batch size ramp

backlog.spec: Replace the standard transformer block with a hybrid block that mixes LSTM residuals with cross-attention, which may fit long-range dependencies more efficiently within the fixed step budget.
backlog.title: Deep LSTM-style residual mixing (Architecture)

backlog.spec: Substitute the standard GEGLU activation with a GeGLU-DA variant that uses compressed values and diagonal approximations to improve gradient flow and potentially reduce overfitting.
backlog.title: Pruned GELU alternative (GELU-DA)

backlog.spec: Add schedule-based dropout to the residual connections. Turn on dropout only in unused layers and scales it with the depth of the current layer to reduce overfitting more effectively than static dropout.
backlog.title: Residual dropout-free training with schedule

backlog.spec: Introduce a prefix mix for the first few layers of the transformer, which may handle initial token patterns more robustly while reducing overall model capacity requirements.
backlog.title: GP neuronal prefix mix (Architecture)

backlog.spec: Introduce a projection layer between the query and value, scaled by a function of the input size to optimize information flow and potentially reduce overfitting.
backlog.title: Value projection scaling (Architecture)

backlog.spec: Implement a dynamic batch size allocator that increases batch size as training progresses, shifting most of the training time to a higher batch size on the A100 to reduce variance and improve generalization.
backlog.title: Batch size dynamic allocation (Batch)

backlog.spec: Apply a reweighting schedule to the Adam optimizer, where weight decay is progressively adjusted to reduce overfitting at later stages of training.
backlog.title: AdamW-style reweighting schedule (Optimizer)

backlog.spec: Introduce a gating mechanism that selectively activates or deactivates specific layers or module components based on the input data distribution, potentially improving generalization to unseen data.
backlog.title: Conditional computation with gating (Architecture)

backlog.spec: Apply a low-rank adaptation to the transformer layers, where only a small subset of parameters are trained, reducing the overall number of trainable parameters while retaining full functionality.
backlog.title: LoRA-style low-rank adaptation (Architecture)

backlog.spec: Introduce a schedule for moment matching in AdamW, which adjusts the momentum decay rate to reduce overfitting and improve generalization.
backlog.title: Moment-reefr Mixing Schedules (Schedule)

backlog.spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.2 to accelerate learning rate decay later in training, potentially avoiding overfitting at low batch sizes.
backlog.title: Short Warmdown to 0.2

backlog.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 to sharpen updates on matrix parameters for the current small batch size.
backlog.title: Increase Matrix LR to 0.06

backlog.spec: Raise UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 to allow faster adaptation of the output projection layer.
backlog.title: Increase Unembedding LR to 0.008

backlog.spec: Implement a linear ramp for TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE starting at 2**16 and scaling to 2**17 over the first 50 seconds of the 300s budget to stabilize early training.
backlog.title: Larger Batch Size Ramp

backlog.spec: Add a per-sample reweighting step in the forward pass that scales gradients by inverse batch size variance, mimicking AdamW regularization.
backlog.title: AdamW-style Reweighting

backlog.spec: Attempt lowering TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**17 to 2**18 to further increase micro-step frequency and noise injection.
backlog.title: Adjacent Batch Size 2**18

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH to 6 and ASPECT_RATIO to 100, keeping model_dim roughly similar but training deeper/larger layers earlier to test gradient persistence.
backlog.title: Depth 6 Wider Mix

backlog.spec: Condition attention output generation on a learned per-token gate if token is within a causal window, skipping computation for irrelevant positions.
backlog.title: Conditional Computation Gate

backlog.spec: Set label smoothing to 0.05 without dropout on the loss side to smooth gradients while maintaining discrete observation counts.
backlog.title: Dropout-Free Label Smoothing 0.05

backlog.spec: Scale the value projection matrix by the inverse square root of head dimension to reduce variance in scaled projections.
backlog.title: Value Projection Scaling

backlog.spec: Replace UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.004 with a schedule that starts high (e.g., 0.01) and ramps down. Higher initial LR for output weights can reduce initialization error variance.
backlog.title: Unembedding LR Ramp

backlog.spec: Attempt to use a negative first momentum term in the AdamW-style Muon optimizer (if supported) or swap signs to explore a less conservative gradient direction. This is a bold architecture-level trick, attempting -0.95 as beta1.
backlog.title: Negative Muon Momentum

backlog.spec: Change ASPECT_RATIO to 40 (model_dim 384) or 54 (model_dim 432) with DEPTH 6. This widens the model but reduces depth, potentially improving fidelity within the 300s budget.
backlog.title: Depth 6 Wider Mix

backlog.spec: Mix a small fraction (e.g., 5%) of unlabeled tokens in the training loop with a fixed probability, using a simple cross-entropy or cosine loss. This can diversify the training distribution and reduce spurious correlation variance.
backlog.title: Unlabeled Festival Loss

backlog.spec: Implement a weighted batch sampling scheme where high-probability tokens are sampled slightly more often, reducing the average degree distribution variance.
backlog.title: Batch Prioritization

backlog.spec: Add a small stochastic noise term (e.g., Gaussian or sparse uniform) to the gradients before the AdamW update, even with weight decay, to reduce bias and improve generalization.
backlog.title: AdamW Unscaled Stochastic Noise

backlog.spec: Zero-initialize all output projection weights if noise is significantly lower than the target values, or restructure the pipeline to minimize initialization error in the final layer.
backlog.title: Zero-Initted Projections Check

backlog.spec: Use a momentum-aware impact (lambda) framework where the sign of a parameter dictates the step, reducing the need for weight decay.
backlog.title: AdamW Lambda Consistency

backlog.spec: Reduce the target value in the final layer by a factor to avoid unnecessary normalization overhead and reduce numerical instability.
backlog.title: Batch Sufficient Target Bias

backlog.spec: Introduce a spectral filter (e.g., Neumann series or low-pass on eigenvalues) to the momentum update, reducing high-frequency components in the gradient updates.
backlog.title: AdamW Spectral Filtering

memo: Helped: slot 5, cutting TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2^17 (official 1.0515/1.0484, delta -0.0646, accepted over 2 runs). It carries a tripwire flag, so check that first. Smaller batches give more optimizer steps in 300 s. Did not help since then: ASPECT_RATIO 80 (+0.0088), HEAD_DIM 64 (+0.0080), DEPTH 10 (+0.0186), MATRIX_LR 0.06 (+0.0057 and +0.0048), WARMUP_RATIO 0.03 (+0.0036), EMBEDDING_LR 0.4 (+0.0031). Weight decay 0.1 was -0.0008, which is a small and unconfirmed gain. Slot 13 (label smoothing) was invalid with a target_leak flag, so avoid it. Earlier architecture gains (SwiGLU-lite -0.0027, SSSSSSSL -0.0017, SSL -0.0015) were measured at the old batch size and are untested on the new one. Next: investigate the tripwire. Try TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^16. Re-test SwiGLU-lite and SSSSSSSL on the incumbent. Try EMBEDDING_LR above 0.6. Replicate weight decay 0.1. Avoid widening or deepening the model.
